title: Degree-one Love numbers

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: Compute the degree 1 loading Love numbers, in normal mode or time-domain form, expressed in the centre of mass reference frame. Degree 1 has fewer modes than degrees 2 and above.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of giamip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.
reference_data.reference_status: closed on 2026-09-15 by Sia Ghelichkhani: the archive spada2011-cost-es0701 is the reference data for this test, and what it lacks is recorded in not_converted and status. New data for a gap is added as a new original, with its own provenance and corrections.

status: converted: GS, GSA, RR, VB and VK in data/converted/spada2011/spada2011-t01-07.nc, h and l of degree 1 as figure 8 draws them. The curves of RR and VB were computed by GS from their normal modes with T01-07/filter.f90, over six of RR's nine modes (correction spada-t01-07-rr-six-of-nine-modes). GS's l is read from column 3 (correction spada-t01-07-gs-l-in-column-3).
